result.title: AIM: Agentic Idea Management for Automated Research
result.summary: Frontier LLMs are increasingly used to automate scientific research through iterative search. We distinguish idea-driven search from solution-driven search and identify three core challenges: organizing evolving research ideas, selecting promising directions, and maintaining alignment between ideas and their implementations. To address these challenges, we introduce the Agentic Idea Manager (AIM), a fully autonomous framework for managing and exploring research directions in idea-driven automated research. Inspired by Bayesian optimization, AIM uses an Agentic Surrogate and an Agentic Acquisition mechanism to organize discovered ideas and guide their selection. A Solution Auditor maintains idea-solution integrity, while a Resource Planner adaptively allocates the remaining experimental budget across parallel search branches. Experiments on 10 AutoLab benchmark tasks show that AIM surpasses the strongest baseline by 1.6 percentage points on System Optimization tasks and 4.9 percentage points on long-horizon Model Development & CUDA tasks. Notably, AIM reaches the best baseline performance up to 3.1x faster in wall-clock time. We further provide a theoretical analysis of when searching over ideas becomes beneficial. Our analysis shows that explicit idea-level allocation makes semantic coverage directly controllable, and that broader coverage becomes increasingly valuable when competitive research directions are sparse among many plausible alternatives. Project Page: https://imhgchoi.github.io/agentic-idea-manager/

AI.brief_summary: AIM 提出一个全自主的「想法管理」框架，用于自动化科研中的 idea-driven 搜索：用 Agentic Surrogate 组织已发现的研究想法，用 Agentic Acquisition 指导方向选择，另有 Solution Auditor 维持想法与实现的对应、Resource Planner 在并行搜索分支间分配实验预算，并在 10 个 AutoLab 任务上验证，同时给出「何时搜索想法更有益」的理论分析。
AI.relevance_reason: 与 LVR 主线的联系是间接的：其贝叶斯优化式「代理评估 + 采集函数」选择分支、以及语义覆盖度可控的想法状态空间，可能为 latent 假设的筛选、多分支搜索的预算分配与停止决策提供方法线索，但未涉及视觉或多模态推理状态，需要人工核查可迁移性。
